title: Aspire Init — LiteSPM
description: **WORKFLOW SKILL** - First-run flow for adding Aspire to a repo. Picks `aspire new` (greenfield) or `aspire init` (existing repo), drops the AppHost skeleton, then hands off to `aspireify` for resource wiring. USE FOR: aspire init, aspire new, aspire-starter, aspire-ts-starter, aspire-py-starter, add Aspire to existing repo, scaffold Aspire app, bootstrap Aspire, no AppHost detected, install aspireify, apphost.mts, generated .aspire/modules. DO NOT USE FOR: AppHost wiring on an existing AppHost (use aspireify), start/stop/wait (use aspire-orchestration), deploy/publish (use aspire-deployment), logs/traces (use aspire-monitoring), repo that already has an AppHost. INVOKES: aspire CLI (init, new, doctor), aspireify (handoff after skeleton drop). FOR SINGLE OPERATIONS: Run `aspire init` or `aspire new TEMPLATE` directly.
